# L5 Narrow / L2 General Classification — api-oss-documentation
**Platform:** Anticloud | **PAX:** 27B | **IP:** USPTO pending 2026, Anticloud FZ LLE
**Domain:** Sovereign auto-generated documentation for Anticloud projects

## L5 Narrow
api-oss-documentation specializes in sovereign auto-generated documentation for anticloud projects within the Anticloud sovereign deployment boundary. All operations stay local — no cloud services, no external APIs, no data exfiltration. The narrow scope ensures deterministic, auditable behavior that PAX 27B can reason about precisely.

## L2 General
L2 General means api-oss-documentation is available to all 9 Anticloud tiers without per-tier configuration. The same API serves hospital, defense, robotics, and research deployments.

## PAX Integration
PAX 27B generates docstrings, usage examples, and architecture diagrams from source code. Every documentation build is AIOSS-chained so the version of docs served matches the audited source version.

## AIOSS Audit Relevance
Every documentation build (source hash + generated docs hash + coverage metric) is AIOSS-chained: H_n = SHA3-256(H_{n-1} || entry_hash_n || timestamp_n).
Tamper-evident, offline-verifiable, zero cloud dependency.

## Regulatory / Compliance
ISO/IEC 26515 (software documentation), NIST SP 800-18 (system security plan)
